values.title: Indexes
values.summary: Add indexes from the schema and find slow queries before your users do.
values.body:
## Declaring an index

schema.ts

```
export const tasks = table("tasks", {
  id: uuid().primaryKey(),
  projectId: uuid(),
  createdAt: timestamp(),
}).index("by_project", ["projectId", "createdAt"])
```

Indexes are created concurrently during migrations, so adding one never locks writes.

## Finding missing indexes

The **Observability** tab lists queries that scanned more than 10,000 rows, along with a suggested index.

Terminal

```
npx tessera db advise --env production
```

## Index types

Type

Use it for

`btree` (default)

Equality and range filters, sorting.

`gin`

`json` columns and full-text search.

`unique`

Enforcing uniqueness across one or more columns.
